english: Grants <pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> Damage Resistance (Resist x2) to you and allies inside Rifts you create. (<solar Well of Radiance /> does not count but you can cast a Rift inside it for the benefits)

source.text:
Grants 25% [5%] Damage Resist to Guardians inside Rifts created by the wielder.
Standing in a Rift that overlaps or is inside a Well of Radiance allow the Damage Resist to work in it.
